name: product-switcher
title: ProductSwitcher
description: The line's products are meant to be used together: kasl-server reads what kasl records, rigger plans what furca commits, a note in scheda cites a track in lyrid. A person moving between them was typing addresses from memory. This is the one place that knows where the others are - the current product's small tile and name on the trigger, and the others in a menu, each with its own tile, so the colour a person already knows the product by is what they look for.
